title: Consultation in School Settings
tagline: Helping the helpers, reaching the child.
welcome: Through consultation, one counselor strengthens many adults, and through them, many children. This course makes you a skilled consultant.
vignette: A teacher says a nine-year-old is 'impossible' and wants him removed. The consultant reframes: the child is stuck, not bad, and offers two strategies to try. Weeks later the teacher reports the room has changed. Consultation multiplied the counselor's reach.
vignette_attr: A teacher consultation, drawn from practice
description: A course in consultation as a core counseling function in schools: consultation models and process, building consultative relationships, teacher and parent consultation, classroom-based strategies, program-level consultation, and evaluating consultation outcomes.
questions: How do I influence an adult without authority over them?
How do I keep the child at the center of adult conversations?
How do I know consultation worked?
importance: Consultation reaches children the counselor never sees
Teachers and parents are the daily change agents
misconceptions: that consultation is giving advice, when it is a collaborative process
that it is secondary to counseling, when it is a primary vehicle of impact
outcomes: You will use process models with fidelity.
You will join with teachers and parents respectfully.
You will move from complaint to plan with an adult.
You will craft feasible, evidence-informed strategies.
You will influence systems, not just cases.
You will measure whether the child and adult improved.
modules: Clarity of role prevents role confusion.
The process gives the conversation a spine.
Teachers are experts on their rooms; we add a lens.
Some problems are solved at the system level.
practicum: A real or simulated consultation case
assessment: Assessment is case and process based.
tips: Start from the adult's concern, end at the child's need
Offer strategies the adult can actually run
Follow up; consultation is a loop, not an event
integration: Consultation multiplies your clinical skill across schools and families.
faith: We serve the servants of children, strengthening many hands with one heart.
closing: May your counsel strengthen every adult around a child, and may the child feel the difference.
